categories.name: Software Feature
categories.description: General functionality or user-facing feature added to an existing software system.
categories.example: Add a real-time collaborative document editing tool with conflict resolution.

categories.name: Software System
categories.description: Standalone software application, centralized platform, or core enterprise service.
categories.example: Build a distributed background task execution engine with priority queues.

categories.name: Distributed System
categories.description: Multi-node systems involving coordination, consistency, replication, partitioning, and distributed state.
categories.example: Design a distributed key-value storage engine using the Raft consensus protocol.

categories.name: Backend/API
categories.description: Backend services, API gateways, business logic, service interfaces, and server-side functionality.
categories.example: Build a high-performance GraphQL schema federation gateway for microservices.

categories.name: Frontend/UI
categories.description: Web, desktop, or user-facing interfaces, component libraries, and frontend architecture.
categories.example: Implement a virtualized data grid component rendering 100,000 real-time rows smoothly.

categories.name: Mobile Application
categories.description: Mobile-specific architecture and features involving device hardware, offline synchronization, and mobile operating systems.
categories.example: Design a background location tracking service optimized for minimal battery drain.

categories.name: Database/Data Storage
categories.description: Database engines, persistence models, indexing, transactions, replication, and storage architectures.
categories.example: Build a multi-region database failover and replica promotion engine.

categories.name: Data Pipeline
categories.description: Streaming ingestion, ETL pipelines, event aggregation, batch transformation, and data movement.
categories.example: Build a real-time clickstream ingestion and aggregation pipeline using Apache Flink.

categories.name: Search/Retrieval
categories.description: Search engines, inverted indexing, information retrieval, ranking, semantic search, and document discovery.
categories.example: Design a hybrid BM25 and dense neural vector search retrieval service.

categories.name: Messaging/Eventing
categories.description: Message brokers, pub/sub systems, event buses, event streams, and asynchronous messaging topologies.
categories.example: Build a high-throughput distributed publish-subscribe message broker.

categories.name: Networking
categories.description: Network routing, overlay networks, software-defined perimeters, packet steering, and connectivity architecture.
categories.example: Design a dynamic path selection controller for software-defined WAN (SD-WAN).

categories.name: Network Protocol
categories.description: Framing, transport layers, wire protocols, custom packet formats, and low-level communication protocols.
categories.example: Design a zero-copy packet serialization protocol for kernel bypass networking.

categories.name: Cloud Infrastructure
categories.description: Multi-region cloud topology, container orchestration, Kubernetes management, and cloud architecture.
categories.example: Design a multi-region cloud infrastructure capable of zero-downtime failover.

categories.name: Infrastructure/Platform
categories.description: Internal developer platforms, secrets management, service discovery, and shared organization platforms.
categories.example: Build an internal developer platform (IDP) with self-service environment provisioning.

categories.name: DevOps/CI-CD
categories.description: Build pipelines, continuous integration, automated canary deployment, and release engineering.
categories.example: Design an autonomous deployment pipeline with automated canary analysis and rollback.

categories.name: Observability/Monitoring
categories.description: Metrics collection, distributed tracing, log aggregation, alerting, and operational monitoring.
categories.example: Build a high-cardinality distributed metrics ingestion and alerting platform.

categories.name: Security/Auth
categories.description: Authentication, authorization, zero-trust mTLS, key management, token verification, and security boundaries.
categories.example: Design a zero-trust microservice mutual TLS (mTLS) certificate issuance authority.

categories.name: Machine Learning System
categories.description: ML training orchestration, feature stores, model serving, inference pipelines, and ML infrastructure.
categories.example: Build a distributed neural model training orchestration engine across multi-GPU clusters.

categories.name: LLM Application
categories.description: LLM inference, RAG assistants, multi-agent reasoning, semantic chunking, and generative AI tools.
categories.example: Design a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) agent with hybrid vector ranking.

categories.name: Computer Vision Pipeline
categories.description: Real-time video processing, object detection, facial recognition, image segmentation, and visual quality inspection.
categories.example: Build a real-time edge object detection and tracking pipeline with TensorRT acceleration.

categories.name: NLP Pipeline
categories.description: Entity extraction, intent classification, sentiment analysis, document categorization, and text processing.
categories.example: Design a multi-lingual document categorization and entity extraction pipeline.

categories.name: Recommendation System
categories.description: Candidate retrieval, neural ranking, collaborative filtering, multi-armed bandits, and personalized feed generation.
categories.example: Build a two-tower neural candidate retrieval and ranking engine for personalized feeds.

categories.name: Autonomous Agent Architecture
categories.description: Task planning, tool invocation, long-term memory consolidation, and self-reflective agent execution loops.
categories.example: Design an autonomous task planning and tool-calling execution agent with replanning.

categories.name: Embedded System
categories.description: Firmware and software executing directly on resource-constrained microcontrollers and edge hardware.
categories.example: Build an ultra-low-power environmental sensor node firmware with deep-sleep scheduling.

categories.name: IoT System
categories.description: Fleet-scale device management, OTA firmware deployment, telemetry aggregation, and IoT edge gateways.
categories.example: Build a fleet-scale IoT device management and delta-OTA firmware update orchestrator.

categories.name: Robotics/Autonomous System
categories.description: Trajectory planning, obstacle avoidance, SLAM sensor fusion, and robotic actuator control.
categories.example: Design a real-time robot trajectory planner and obstacle avoidance controller.

categories.name: Sensor/Instrumentation System
categories.description: Multi-channel data acquisition, sensor signal conditioning, instrumentation amplifiers, and calibration.
categories.example: Design a precision 24-bit multi-channel data acquisition (DAQ) instrumentation unit.

categories.name: Power Electronics
categories.description: Switched-mode power supplies, DC/DC converters, inverters, gate drivers, and high-efficiency power conversion.
categories.example: Design a high-efficiency 48 V to 12 V DC/DC buck converter for airborne electronics.

categories.name: PCB Design
categories.description: Multi-layer PCB layout, high-speed routing, mixed-signal partitioning, stackup design, and board integration.
categories.example: Design a high-speed 12-layer PCB layout for multi-gigabit PCIe and DDR4 routing.

categories.name: FPGA/ASIC
categories.description: Digital logic design, Verilog/VHDL hardware modules, FPGA accelerators, and custom ASIC architectures.
categories.example: Design a pipelined hardware packet parsing and filtering engine implemented in Verilog.

categories.name: Thermal Management
categories.description: Liquid cooling loops, heat sinks, thermal interface materials, convection modeling, and thermal dissipation.
categories.example: Design an active liquid cooling thermal regulation loop for high-density GPU server chassis.

categories.name: RF/Microwave Design
categories.description: Low-noise amplifiers, RF power amplifiers, mixers, synthesizers, and high-frequency microwave circuits.
categories.example: Design a 5.8 GHz low-noise amplifier (LNA) with integrated input impedance matching.

categories.name: Antenna Design
categories.description: Phased array antennas, patch arrays, beamforming, impedance matching networks, and radiation optimization.
categories.example: Design a phased array beamforming antenna array for satellite communications.

categories.name: Signal Integrity
categories.description: High-speed transmission lines, SERDES eye-diagram analysis, jitter budgeting, and power distribution network (PDN) impedance.
categories.example: Perform differential pair routing and jitter budget analysis for 25 Gbps SERDES links.

categories.name: EMI/EMC/Noise Mitigation
categories.description: Electromagnetic compatibility, common-mode filtering, shielding enclosures, grounding, and emissions suppression.
categories.example: Design a common-mode choke and differential EMI filter stage for industrial motor drives.

categories.name: Hardware/Software Integration
categories.description: Hardware-in-the-loop testing, PCIe DMA kernel drivers, HAL layers, and hardware abstraction interfaces.
categories.example: Build a hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) automated test bench for flight controller validation.

categories.name: Microcontroller Firmware
categories.description: Bare-metal drivers, RTOS task management, peripheral drivers, and low-level MCU firmware architectures.
categories.example: Build a bare-metal interrupt-driven state machine for industrial valve actuation.

categories.name: Operating System Component
categories.description: Virtual memory page handlers, thread schedulers, IPC mechanisms, virtual file systems, and kernel drivers.
categories.example: Design a custom virtual memory page-fault handler and demand-paging subsystem.

categories.name: Storage Engine
categories.description: LSM-tree compaction, copy-on-write B-trees, NVMe commit logs, zero-copy caching, and disk storage architectures.
categories.example: Build a log-structured merge-tree (LSM) storage engine with tiered compaction strategies.

categories.name: High-Performance Computing
categories.description: MPI cluster computing, CUDA parallel reduction kernels, NUMA memory architectures, and SIMD vectorization.
categories.example: Implement an MPI-distributed parallel matrix multiplication engine with non-blocking transfers.

categories.name: Distributed Consensus
categories.description: Multi-Paxos state machines, Raft leader election, Byzantine fault tolerance, and causal broadcast ordering.
categories.example: Implement a Multi-Paxos replicated state machine with active leader leases and pipelining.

categories.name: Compiler/Runtime Engine
categories.description: JIT compilation tiers, generational garbage collectors, bytecode interpreters, and LLVM optimization passes.
categories.example: Build a just-in-time (JIT) compiler tier with SSA-based dead code elimination and inlining.

categories.name: Real-Time System
categories.description: Hard real-time schedulers, deterministic task execution, priority-inheritance mutexes, and low-jitter systems.
categories.example: Design a hard real-time avionics mission computer with guaranteed sub-millisecond jitter.

categories.name: Audio Signal Processing
categories.description: Acoustic echo cancellation, spatial 3D audio convolution, FIR filtering, and psychoacoustic DSP algorithms.
categories.example: Build a real-time multi-channel acoustic echo cancellation (AEC) DSP pipeline.

categories.name: Video Streaming/Encoding
categories.description: WebRTC live encoding, adaptive bitrate ladders, HLS/DASH packaging, and hardware transcode pipelines.
categories.example: Build a low-latency WebRTC live video encoding pipeline with dynamic bitrate scaling.

categories.name: AR/VR System
categories.description: 6DoF optical head tracking, asynchronous timewarp compositing, spatial rendering, and foveated graphics.
categories.example: Design a six-degree-of-freedom (6DoF) optical head-tracking and pose prediction pipeline.

categories.name: Blockchain/Web3
categories.description: EVM execution engines, zero-knowledge rollup proof generation, cryptographic state validation, and peer consensus.
categories.example: Build an EVM-compatible smart contract execution virtual machine with gas accounting.

categories.name: Simulation Engine
categories.description: Physics collision detection BVH trees, rigid-body multi-body dynamics, discrete-event simulations, and fluid dynamics.
categories.example: Build a high-performance physics collision detection engine using bounding volume hierarchies (BVH).

categories.name: Gaming Engine/Subsystem
categories.description: Entity Component Systems (ECS), client-side prediction netcode, LOD geometry streaming, and game runtime systems.
categories.example: Design an entity-component-system (ECS) architecture with cache-friendly contiguous memory layout.

categories.name: Safety-Critical System
categories.description: Dual-channel fail-operational voting controllers, ISO 26262 ASIL-D braking architectures, and SIL-3 safety systems.
categories.example: Design a dual-channel fail-operational voting controller for fly-by-wire flight control.

categories.name: Automotive Software
categories.description: AUTOSAR Adaptive platforms, CAN-FD / Automotive Ethernet gateways, ADAS emergency braking, and EV battery management.
categories.example: Build an AUTOSAR Classic adaptive platform gateway for CAN-FD and Automotive Ethernet.

categories.name: Avionics Software
categories.description: DO-178C Level A flight displays, ARINC 653 partition managers, FMS navigation, and dual-redundant flight control.
categories.example: Build a DO-178C Level A certified primary flight display (PFD) graphics rendering engine.

categories.name: Bioinformatics Pipeline
categories.description: Genomic sequence alignment, variant calling, RNA-seq normalization, and protein tertiary structure folding.
categories.example: Build a distributed genomic sequence alignment and variant calling pipeline using Burrows-Wheeler.

categories.name: Medical Device Software
categories.description: IEC 62304 Class C patient ventilation, CGM glucose prediction, ECG arrhythmia detection, and surgical robot controls.
categories.example: Design IEC 62304 Class C compliant patient-ventilator closed-loop pressure control software.
